name: epidomastegasis.gr
body: Unknown paths answer 404, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 1 page has no title.
lesson: Give every page a unique title of about 60 characters: the page first, the site second.
summary: www.epidomastegasis.gr scores 62 out of 100 (D). 7 checks fail now, 32 are at risk, and 19 pass. Fix first: 1 page has no title.

fix.title: 1 page has no title
fix.fix: Give every page a unique title of about 30 to 60 characters.

fix.title: The start page does not declare its language
fix.evidence: Screen readers pick the wrong voice and browsers offer the wrong translation.

fix.title: Elements must have their visible text as part of their accessible name
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 4 elements on /pub/Home/Index, /gov/AdminAccount/Login?ReturnUrl=%2Fgov%2FAdminApplication%2FIndex, for example .cc-link and .cc-btn. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Start the aria-label with the words that are visible on the control.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on 6 of 7 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: 4 cookies are sent without Secure
fix.evidence: Without Secure: EPIDOMA_STEGASIS-COOKIE_ID, cookiesession1, ASP.NET_SessionId, __RequestVerificationToken_L3B1Yg2. Set on /, /pub/Home/Index, /pub/Home/Info and 4 more.
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

fix.title: 11 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
HSTS is sent with a long max-age
The page fits a 390 px phone screen
The start page arrived in 765 ms
The start page sets a mobile viewport
